file_role: Operator context amendment — re-classifies the case-context ingestion path for run QMDJ-P3-001. This is an explicit, logged re-classification by the operator who cast the chart; it is NOT a silent upgrade and the v1 stamp is retained beside it (charter hard_rule: 'A degraded context never silently upgrades to full authority').
operator_declaration: The assignment brief IS the case context, and it is the reason the chart was cast.

charter_basis.accept_formats: case_context_ingest.accept_formats = [YAML, JSON, free_prose] — prose is an accepted ingestion format, so the brief is not, by itself, a schema violation
charter_basis.free_text_fallback: case_context_ingest.free_text_fallback.allowed = true; procedure CAP-17 decomposes the text into slots/facts/unknowns and tags every derived row DECOMPOSED
charter_basis.key_aliases_applied: the brief's own key names were mapped through the alias table where they match (title/format/submission/submission_date/assignment_objective); the remaining slots were decomposed from prose (DECOMPOSED)
charter_basis.degradation_rule_query: the v1 stamp was produced by the clause 'Any input not matching the schema exactly is stamped CONTEXT_DEGRADED'. The operator's declaration resolves the ambiguity between that clause and the explicit free_prose acceptance: the accepted path is free_prose, and the degradation stamp is superseded rather than deleted.

what_changes: package header context_status: CONTEXT_DEGRADED -> CONTEXT_FREE_PROSE_ACCEPTED (v1 stamp retained in 02_case_context_digest.v1_stamp)
the six charter case-context slots are now populated from the brief, each with its raw sentence beside it and each tagged DECOMPOSED
facet-cap ranking criterion: SOURCE_DEPENDENCY_ORDER (A-010) -> DECISION_RELEVANCE, ranked against the brief's own evaluation criteria
QUESTION_OVERLOAD is now logged (CAP-17 step 4 requires it to be reported; the v1 run reported the facet cap in the digest but did not raise the anomaly code)
case timeframe is now available for the deliverable's horizon (the brief's two-week calendar cycle and its 5th October 2026 submission date)
what_cannot_change: any chart-derived claim, evidence atom, relation, archetype, score or ledger number (charter cc1: case context decides WHAT MATTERS, not WHAT IS TRUTH; cc2: no claim may cite case_context as support)
the six BLOCKED protocol classes (HC/AX/ZQ/CS/JG/QT remain unsupplied)
the ABSENT slots (void, horse; and heaven stem, gate, deity at the centre)
C010's limitation: the case timeframe is a deadline the operator supplied, not chart timing; the chart still supplies no civil date or clock time
authority_note: Per the charter, rows derived from prose never enter CONK/UNK at full authority: a CONFLICT_WITH_KNOWN check against a DECOMPOSED fact downgrades to POTENTIAL_CONFLICT instead of veto. CONK01-CONK04 are therefore re-stamped CONK_DECOMPOSED with POTENTIAL_CONFLICT semantics. No live verdict conflicts with any of them, so no claim moves.

casting_reason.value: A student must produce Assignment 2 of a marketing course: a content and social media strategy for their own brand, building on the strategic foundation created in Assignment 1, for submission on 5th October 2026.
raw_quotes: assignment.subtitle: "Build your brand's digital content ecosystem"

assignment.assignment_objective: "Using the strategic foundation created in Assignment 1, develop a content and social media strategy that shows how your brand will attract, engage and build relationships with its target audience."

question.value: What content and social media strategy should this brand run - what must the content achieve, how should the brand speak, on which surfaces, with what ideas, and with what participant and creator programmes?
raw_quotes: assignment.suggested_slide_structure[0].content[0]: "What does content need to achieve for your brand?"
assignment.suggested_slide_structure[1].content[0]: "Define how the brand should communicate online."
assignment.suggested_slide_structure[10].answer: "Then answer: After one month, how would you know whether your strategy is working?"

subject.value: project: the student's own brand (the persona is the brand's target audience)
raw_quotes: assignment.suggested_slide_structure[3].note: "...justify your selection based on the persona created in Assignment 1."

domain.value: other: marketing / brand content strategy (the charter's domain list carries no marketing class; 'other' is the honest bind)

timeframe_of_interest.value: The assignment cycle: a two-week content horizon, submitted 5th October 2026. This is a CASE timeframe (a deliverable deadline), not chart timing.

decision_needed.value: Which content and social media strategy to commit to and submit - objectives, message and tone, pillars, platforms, the adapted idea, concepts, the hero idea, participant mechanisms, creator approach, the two-week calendar and the measurement set.

facet_ranking.ranking_key: the brief's own evaluation criteria: (1) strategic relevance, (2) creative thinking, (3) platform understanding, (4) integration
facet_ranking.deferred_reason: execution support: none of the four evaluation criteria names them; they are graded only through 'integration'. The charter's 7-facet cap is hard, so they remain deferred - unchanged from v1.
facet_ranking.result_vs_v1: the split is identical (Q1-Q7 analysed, Q8-Q11 deferred); only the criterion and its justification changed
